entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The Shadows probably won't come[n]in here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: *gasp* *pant* How can you tell?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's a lack of distortion here, meaning[n]the ruler's control over this area is weak.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is this a classroom!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now do you understand?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This place is another reality that the ruler's[n]heart projects.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This is Kamoshida's reality? Shit makes[n]no sense at all!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: One could say it's a world in which one's[n]distorted desires have materialized.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I call such a place a "Palace."

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A Palace?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is happening because he thinks[n]the school is his own castle.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, it became like this 'cause he just[n]thought of it like that!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hahaha...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That son of a bitch!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You must really hate this Kamoshida guy.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hate doesn't even cover how I feel.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Everything is that asshole's fault!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I don't know what happened between[n]you two, but don't let your emotions get[n]the better of you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: His lackeys are everywhere inside.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're curious about your outfit,[n]aren't you?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, I'm curious as hell about it too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's also because of this world.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: More stuff that makes no sense...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anything distorts according to how a ruler[n]pleases within his Palace.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A school can turn into a castle like this,[n]after all.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: In order to prevent such distortions, one[n]must hold a powerful will of rebellion.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Your appearance is a manifestation of[n]that. It's the image of rebellion that you[n]hold within.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uuugh, I'm so fed up with all this!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm more curious about you than his[n]clothes! What the hell are you anyways!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm a human—an honest-to-god human!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: No, you're obviously more like a cat!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is, well... It's because I lost my[n]true form.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I think.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You think?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But I do know how to regain my true form.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The reason why I snuck in here was for a[n]preliminary investigation of those means.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, I ended up getting caught though...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Besides, I've been tortured by[n]Kamoshida too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm gonna make him pay for sure!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What is this, a comic book? This is[n]seriously crazy...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we're gonna keep going, we should[n]hurry along.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll be counting on your skills this time[n]too, rookie. Got it?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't worry, I'm not gonna force it all[n]on you. I thought it might help, so...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I brought this just in case! It's a model[n]gun though, so it only makes sounds!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's a toy!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But it looks totally real, so it'll at least[n]fake 'em out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I brought some medicine too. You[n]know what they say: "Providin' is[n]pre... something." Huh? Huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So you were planning this from the start...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, fine. If you're ready to go, we'll[n]resume our infiltration.
